inventory_completion_explanation: Each of the twelve declared roadmap families decomposes into six distinct carrier/relation/record/evidence/falsification obligations. The resulting count follows the decomposition rather than a requested target.
later_full_field_extensions: complete social network group organization and institution census
complete anthropology archaeology sociology family and community studies
complete governance law politics economics labour and inequality evidence
complete demography migration geography city and settlement evidence
complete culture language education religion media and knowledge transmission
complete criminology justice conflict peace and social-harm evidence
complete multi-agent artificial collective and institutional knowledge studies
complete causal intervention replication ethics and cross-context limits

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a person, role, organization or artificial agent is silently substituted for another.
obligations.statement: A social agent is a bounded acting and observed carrier whose identity, capability, context and alternatives remain explicit.
obligations.title: Social agent

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if co-presence, correlation or one-sided reporting proves a reciprocal relation.
obligations.statement: A social relation is a typed, directed or reciprocal interaction between identified agents in a declared context.
obligations.title: Social relation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a label or sample is treated as a coherent group without membership evidence.
obligations.statement: A group retains membership, boundary, purpose, entry, exit and internal disagreement rather than becoming an indivisible person.
obligations.title: Group identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an aggregate erases all constituent variation or becomes an individual mind.
obligations.statement: A collective state composes agent states and relations while retaining internal distribution and minority states.
obligations.title: Collective state

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a legal name alone establishes stable organization or unchanged purpose.
obligations.statement: An organization is a versioned arrangement of members, roles, rules, resources and processes.
obligations.title: Organization identity

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject universal inference from favorable respondents or an undefined denominator.
obligations.statement: A social population is a sampling-frame-bound agent set with selection, weighting, censoring and missingness retained.
obligations.title: Social population

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if observation is treated as intervention-free or private inference as direct report.
obligations.statement: Social observation retains observer, method, consent, setting, reactivity and unavailable records.
obligations.title: Social observation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if outcome alone proves intent or if constrained conduct is treated as free choice.
obligations.statement: Action attribution retains capability, alternatives, constraints, intent evidence, act and consequence.
obligations.title: Social action

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if sending proves receipt, receipt proves belief, or exposure proves action.
obligations.statement: A communication event retains sender, content, channel, recipient opportunity, reception and loss.
obligations.title: Communication event

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if one party's record becomes uncontested collective memory.
obligations.statement: A shared record is a versioned artifact with authorship, access, custody, changes and disputes retained.
obligations.title: Shared social record

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject completed infinite mutual knowledge or infer it from a public message alone.
obligations.statement: Common knowledge claims require a declared finite mutual-observation depth and complete receipt chain.
obligations.title: Common-knowledge boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if disagreement is automatically deception or if a transformed message is called identical.
obligations.statement: Communication noise retains technical loss, ambiguity, reinterpretation and audience differences.
obligations.title: Social communication noise

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if simultaneous action proves a shared target or successful coordination proves cooperation.
obligations.statement: Coordination is compatible action around a declared target with dependencies, timing and failures retained.
obligations.title: Coordination

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if aggregate gain hides uncompensated loss or coerced contribution.
obligations.statement: Cooperation retains contributions, costs, benefits, alternatives and defection for identified participants.
obligations.title: Cooperation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if unequal access is hidden or all parallel striving is called competition.
obligations.statement: Competition is a rule- and resource-bounded rival claim with opportunities and exclusion retained.
obligations.title: Competition

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if disagreement alone becomes violence or one source defines every party's claim.
obligations.statement: Conflict retains incompatible claims, capabilities, actions, harms, alternatives and time.
obligations.title: Conflict

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if the final agreement proves equal choice or erased alternatives.
obligations.statement: Bargaining retains offers, outside options, information, power, time, breakdown and agreement.
obligations.title: Bargaining

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if outcome visibility erases nonparticipants or failed attempts.
obligations.statement: Collective action retains participation, abstention, contribution, threshold, benefit, failure and context.
obligations.title: Collective action

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if researcher preference or majority behavior alone becomes a norm.
obligations.statement: A norm is a context-bound expectation evidenced by behavior and responses to conformity and violation.
obligations.title: Social norm

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an unwritten inference is presented as a universal rule or version changes disappear.
obligations.statement: A rule retains issuer, text, version, scope, subjects, exceptions, application and contestation.
obligations.title: Social rule

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if institutional prestige is used as evidence or if internal conflict is erased.
obligations.statement: An institution is a historically repeated governed process, not merely a building, name or consensus.
obligations.title: Institution

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a written rule proves uniform enforcement or punishment proves legitimacy.
obligations.statement: Enforcement retains monitoring, selectivity, procedure, response, appeal and non-enforcement.
obligations.title: Enforcement

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if observed conformity proves acceptance or nonconformity proves knowledge.
obligations.statement: Compliance and resistance remain distinct from ignorance, inability, concealment and coincidence.
obligations.title: Compliance and resistance

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a later state is used as its own causal history.
obligations.statement: Institutional change is a source-dated transition retaining continuity, conflict and alternative accounts.
obligations.title: Institutional change

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if familiarity, approval or one successful outcome proves general trust.
obligations.statement: Trust is domain-specific reliance under vulnerability with history, action, outcome and breach retained.
obligations.title: Trust relation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if popularity or repeated rumor becomes verified character.
obligations.statement: Reputation is a network of attributed reports whose sources, incentives, conflicts and audiences remain visible.
obligations.title: Reputation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if status alone establishes truth or marginal status establishes falsity.
obligations.statement: Testimony retains speaker access, claim, support, conflicts, audience and reception without credential substitution.
obligations.title: Testimony and credibility

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if consensus vote replaces evidence or inaccessible content is called shared knowledge.
obligations.statement: Collective knowledge is distributed, recorded and validated content with contribution, access and disagreement retained.
obligations.title: Collective knowledge

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject credential, title or confidence as sufficient evidence of a claim.
obligations.statement: Expertise is domain- and task-bound competence evidenced by methods and performance, not a universal authority token.
obligations.title: Expertise evidence boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if dissent is labelled false by status or if later correction erases prior reach.
obligations.statement: False, unsupported, disputed and corrected claims remain distinct and source-dated.
obligations.title: False and unsupported social information

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if a price alone describes rights, coercion, quality or distribution.
obligations.statement: Exchange retains parties, items, rights, terms, timing, costs and failed transfers.
obligations.title: Exchange

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if market price, vote or survey mean is equated with universal human value.
obligations.statement: Valuation is agent-, purpose-, option- and context-bound and cannot become an intrinsic universal scalar by declaration.
obligations.title: Social valuation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if distributed shares omit the stock, denominator or excluded claimants.
obligations.statement: Allocation retains total resources, claimants, rule, priority, outcome, unmet claims and losses.
obligations.title: Resource allocation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if output alone erases contributors, unpaid inputs, waste or ownership.
obligations.statement: Production retains labour, material, knowledge, ownership, transformation, output and loss.
obligations.title: Collective production

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if an average, rank or index replaces the complete share distribution.
obligations.statement: Distribution retains population, total stock, shares, access, time and missing members.
obligations.title: Distribution and inequality

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject cross-sectional difference as individual mobility or omit those lost to follow-up.
obligations.statement: Mobility is a cohort- and measure-bound transition retaining paths, attrition and opportunity structure.
obligations.title: Social mobility

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject status, wealth or outcome alone as complete power evidence.
obligations.statement: Power is a directional capacity to alter another's available actions, retaining resources, dependency and resistance.
obligations.title: Power relation

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject effective coercion as legitimate authority or formal title as effective control.
obligations.statement: Authority is scoped decision capacity with source, procedure, recognition and contestation retained.
obligations.title: Authority

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject repeated interaction or correlation as dependency without the alternative boundary.
obligations.statement: Dependency retains the needed resource, controller, alternatives, costs and failures.
obligations.title: Social dependency

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject if only successful applicants define access or if absence from a system proves free choice.
obligations.statement: Exclusion retains opportunity, eligibility, gate, decision, appeal and unobserved discouraged cases.
obligations.title: Exclusion

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject universal hierarchy from one measure, institution or historical context.
obligations.statement: Stratification is persistent ordered access across a declared population and resource set with mobility retained.
obligations.title: Stratification

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject prestige as scientific evidence or criticism of prestige as automatic admission of a claim.
obligations.statement: Gatekeeping evidence retains criteria, costs, credentials, decisions, appeals and contributions made invisible by exclusion.
obligations.title: Scientific and institutional gatekeeping

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject an abstract edge as a social tie without measurement or infer absent links outside the sample.
obligations.statement: A social network retains node identity, link meaning, direction, time, sampling and missing links.
obligations.title: Social network

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject temporal clustering as peer transmission or exposure as adoption.
obligations.statement: Diffusion retains source, path, exposure opportunity, adoption, nonadoption and external inputs.
obligations.title: Social diffusion

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject coincident peaks or shared schedules as endogenous synchronization.
obligations.statement: Synchronization is recurrent phase relation with coupling, lag, breaks and common-cause controls retained.
obligations.title: Collective synchronization

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject aggregate change without an observed transmission chain as a cascade.
obligations.statement: A cascade retains ordered local transitions, paths, nontransitions and external causes.
obligations.title: Collective cascade

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject one threshold or Fold coordinate as a universal physical social tipping value.
obligations.statement: Collective transition is a population-distribution change with drivers, controls, reversals and historical boundary retained.
obligations.title: Collective transition

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject two peaks or a narrative phase label as a universal periodic law.
obligations.statement: A social cycle requires recurrence under a declared state definition and retains shocks, broken cycles and measurement change.
obligations.title: Socio-economic cycle

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject stereotype, majority report or one observer's taxonomy as complete culture.
obligations.statement: Culture is historically transmitted and varied practice and meaning, not an immutable property of a labelled group.
obligations.title: Culture

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject a form as carrying one universal social meaning without a community bridge.
obligations.statement: A symbol's social meaning is user-, context- and history-bound with alternatives retained.
obligations.title: Social symbol and meaning

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject standard variety, dictionary or state boundary as the whole language community.
obligations.statement: A language community retains speakers, varieties, contexts, power, change and corpus limits.
obligations.title: Language community

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject credential attainment as complete learning or nonattendance as inability.
obligations.statement: Education evidence retains access, instruction, participation, assessment, attrition and context.
obligations.title: Education and knowledge transmission

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject published content as received information or platform metrics as all social response.
obligations.statement: A media system retains ownership, production, selection, distribution, reach, response and missing exposure.
obligations.title: Media system

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject dominant narrative as complete history or a destroyed record as evidence of no event.
obligations.statement: Collective memory is a contested transmission of records, narratives and practices with omissions retained.
obligations.title: Collective memory

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject an average as a causal collective agent or infer each individual from the aggregate.
obligations.statement: Individual states compose a collective only through an explicit relation and aggregation rule retaining lost distinctions.
obligations.title: Individual-to-collective composition

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject a macro label as direct cause without a transmission path.
obligations.statement: Collective structures affect individuals through observable rules, resources, exposure and expectations.
obligations.title: Collective-to-individual constraint

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject complexity language as proof or erase component contributions.
obligations.statement: An emergent collective property is composition-dependent and not identical to any one component, with tests and scale retained.
obligations.title: Collective emergence

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject simulated coordination as real-world governance evidence or opaque agents as lawful social causes.
obligations.statement: A mixed collective retains human and artificial agent types, protocols, resources, failures and oversight.
obligations.title: Human and artificial multi-agent collective

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject majority outcome as unanimous preference, truth or ethical legitimacy.
obligations.statement: Collective decision retains eligibility, options, information, rule, participation, dissent and implementation.
obligations.title: Collective decision

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject ecological or atomistic inference without a cross-level bridge.
obligations.statement: Aggregation explicitly records the many-to-one loss preventing recovery of individual states from totals.
obligations.title: Aggregation and ecological inference boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject a single archive, victor narrative or later outcome as the complete event.
obligations.statement: A historical event is a source-custodied reconstruction retaining perspectives, gaps and competing accounts.
obligations.title: Historical social event

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject inevitability from hindsight or universal law from one historical path.
obligations.statement: Contingency retains prior alternatives, event sequence, mechanism and unresolved counterfactuals.
obligations.title: Historical contingency

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject association, model coefficient or adjusted significance as causation without design support.
obligations.statement: Causal inference retains assignment, comparison, confounding, spillover, attrition and target population.
obligations.title: Social causal inference

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject policy announcement as implementation or average benefit as absence of harm.
obligations.statement: Intervention evidence retains target, delivery, uptake, context, comparison, harms and missing outcomes.
obligations.title: Social intervention

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject same label with changed construct as replication or one failure as universal impossibility.
obligations.statement: Replication retains populations, settings, measures, protocol deviations, adverse outcomes and transport limits.
obligations.title: Cross-context replication

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject empirical frequency as moral permission or moral commitment as measured causal fact.
obligations.statement: Ethical judgment retains affected agents, rights, harms, benefits, disagreement and power and is not relabelled an empirical law.
obligations.title: Ethical and value boundary

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject an unlabeled graph as a social network law.
obligations.statement: Social Science supplies measured meaning; Mathematics supplies abstract structure without selecting social identity.
obligations.title: Mathematics and graph handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject platform behavior or consensus protocol as a universal human law.
obligations.statement: Computation may simulate a declared social process but cannot make simulated behavior an observation.
obligations.title: Computation and distributed-system handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject biological reduction of an institution or social attribution of a private quale without evidence.
obligations.statement: Individual mechanisms and experience remain upstream evidence linked to, but not replaced by, collective relations.
obligations.title: Biology, consciousness and individual cognition handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject population association as individual diagnosis or clinical efficacy as equal access.
obligations.statement: Medicine owns clinical state; Social Science owns collective access and distribution; public-health composition retains both.
obligations.title: Medicine and public-health handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject physical hazard as identical social harm or policy as an Earth law.
obligations.statement: Earth Science owns hazard; Social Science owns exposure, vulnerability, collective response and unequal impact.
obligations.title: Earth and environmental handoff

obligations.falsification_condition: Reject a successful product metric as scientific admission or a failed implementation as automatic law falsification.
obligations.statement: Engineering may test implementations against social laws but applications cannot select or rewrite those laws.
obligations.title: Engineering and policy implementation handoff

ownership_boundary.owned: Genuinely collective human and multi-agent phenomena with historical, cultural and institutional context retained.

scope: Agents, relations, groups, collective identity, observation, communication, coordination, institutions, trust, exchange, distribution, power, networks, culture, cross-level causation, history, intervention, ethics and typed handoffs.
